breaking.change: Each evaluated entry is limited to 64 MiB of canonical binary output, one million structural nodes and 128 nested containers; typed array samples occupy a packed buffer rather than individual structural nodes.
breaking.fix: Split larger worlds into independently cooked tiles or content entries and use numeric typed arrays for dense samples. Do not rely on one unbounded default export.

added.summary: Transfers deterministic authored values from the closed evaluator to owned canonical binary data and caches those same bytes. Numeric typed arrays retain element type, little-endian samples and view bounds instead of expanding through JSON text. The existing JSON consumer entry projects this one representation; there is no second evaluator or old-cache fallback. Project/content graph integration and author-format cutovers remain separate.
